snippet.title: Kaperfahrt Announcement Trailer | Open World Pirate Sandbox
snippet.description:
The pirate sandbox I waited twenty years for, so I built it myself. 

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4943150/Kaperfahrt

Kaperfahrt is an open Caribbean built by one developer. Board an enemy ship and it sails under your flag from that day on. Blockade a harbor and grain prices climb, because the economy truly reacts. Hunt the 23 infamous captains of the Blacklist, each with their own agenda. Five houses struggle for power, and the weather decides how brave you sail.

Playtest signups are open on the Steam page. 
The first waves start as soon as the build meets the bar.

Planned for December 2026. Windows PC.

Website and press kit:
https://kleinodgames.com/

TikTok:
https://www.tiktok.com/@UCLPRPqLs1LiogweIvDAw-4Q 

#pirategame #indiegame #openworld
